title: メジロのプラビでパーリナイ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Helios in the hooouse! ☆ Yo, this VIP BBQ is craaacked! I got the fireworks, so let's pop off and light up the sky!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Pop off… Oh, like popcorn?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: She just means let's have fun with the fireworks she brought over!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ahh, is that so? Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: When the news came you'd be bringing a fresh face around, I had my expectations…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: But it would seem we're in for a fresh, new experience. We welcome you to our abode, Helios.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'll get some drinks. Is there anything you'd like?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Thanks! I'll have whatever Palmster's having!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Palmster…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh no, upon hearing it again, I was reminded of how sweet of a nickname it is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the BBQ at the Mejiros' private beach gets off to a lively start…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Dang! This cookin' slaps! You guys always eat this good?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'm glad the food is to your tastes. Please, have as much as you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Bet! Big ups, Ardan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm just as grateful. Please continue to be good friends with our Palmster.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Did you say "Palmster"?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I grew a little envious of your bond. So I thought to try calling you that myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Palmster, I'm finished grilling the carrots.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hey, come on! This is kinda embarrassing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Haha! If only McQueen was here to see this, Palmster.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Not you too, Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the members of the Mejiro family all start to hop on the "Palmster" bandwagon.
